subject: Report the real error when a reply schema fails validation (#4703)
reason: The change modifies only utils/req-res-log-validator.py, a Python developer/test utility that validates reply-schema logs; it alters error reporting in that script, not any behaviour of valkey-server, replication, cluster, or the shipped tools. The fuzzer exercises real servers and Valkey binaries, none of which execute this script, so no scenario can reach the change and none is needed.
